intro.en: A father and mother are shocked by a high electricity bill. They talk about the many electric devices at home and try a clever idea to save electricity. Notice the word كَثيراً (kathīran) meaning 'a lot'.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein walid aur walida bijli ke bade bill par baat karte hain. Ghar ke bijli ke aalaat ginte hain aur bijli bachane ka ek tareeqa aazmate hain. Lafz كَثيراً (kathīran) ka matlab hai 'bahut'.
intro.ar: يُفاجَأُ أَبٌ وَأُمٌّ بِفاتورَةِ كَهْرَباءَ مُرْتَفِعَةٍ، فَيَتَحَدَّثانِ عَنِ الأَجْهِزَةِ الكَهْرَبائِيَّةِ الكَثيرَةِ في البَيْتِ وَيُجَرِّبانِ فِكْرَةً ذَكِيَّةً لِتَوْفيرِ الكَهْرَباءِ. لاحِظْ كَلِمَةَ «كَثيراً».

dialogue.ar: تَضاعَفَتْ فاتورَةُ الكَهْرَباءِ هذا الشَّهْرَ!
dialogue.tr: taḍāʿafat fātūratu l-kahrabāʾi hādhā sh-shahra
dialogue.en: The electricity bill has doubled this month!
dialogue.ur: Is mahine bijli ka bill dugna ho gaya!

dialogue.ar: لا عَجَبَ في ذلِكَ، فَقَدْ أَصْبَحْنا نَسْتَهْلِكُ الكَهْرَباءَ كَثيراً: في الإِضاءَةِ، وَالحاسوبِ، وَالمِذْياعِ، وَالخَلّاطِ، وَالفُرْنِ الكَهْرَبائِيِّ، وَالغَسّالَةِ، وَالمِكْنَسَةِ الكَهْرَبائِيَّةِ، وَغَيْرِ ذلِكَ.
dialogue.tr: lā ʿajaba fī dhālika, faqad aṣbaḥnā nastahliku l-kahrabāʾa kathīran: fī l-iḍāʾati, wal-ḥāsūbi, wal-midhyāʿi, wal-khallāṭi, wal-furni l-kahrabāʾiyyi, wal-ghassālati, wal-miknasati l-kahrabāʾiyyati, wa ghayri dhālika
dialogue.en: No wonder, we now use a lot of electricity: lights, computer, radio, blender, electric oven, washing machine, vacuum cleaner and more.
dialogue.ur: Koi hairat nahi, hum bijli bahut istemal karne lage hain: roshni, computer, radio, blender, bijli ka tandoor, dhulai machine, vacuum cleaner aur baqi cheezein.

dialogue.ar: أُلاحِظُ أَنَّ الأَوْلادَ يَتْرُكونَ الأَجْهِزَةَ الكَهْرَبائِيَّةَ تَعْمَلُ طَوالَ اليَوْمِ، وَكَذلِكَ الإِضاءَةَ، وَهذا تَبْذيرٌ.
dialogue.tr: ulāḥiẓu anna l-awlāda yatrukūna l-ajhizata l-kahrabāʾiyyata taʿmalu ṭawāla l-yawmi, wa kadhālika l-iḍāʾata, wa hādhā tabdhīr
dialogue.en: I notice the children leave the electric devices running all day, and the lights too. This is waste.
dialogue.ur: Main dekhta hoon bachay bijli ke aalaat poora din chalta chhod dete hain, roshni bhi. Yeh fuzool kharchi hai.

dialogue.ar: تَكَلَّمْنا مَعَ الأَوْلادِ كَثيراً، وَقُلْنا لَهُمْ: نَحْنُ نَسْتَهْلِكُ الكَهْرَباءَ كَثيراً جِدّاً، وَهذا يُؤَثِّرُ في مِيزانِيَّةِ البَيْتِ، وَلكِنْ لا مُسْتَجيبَ لِما نَقولُ.
dialogue.tr: takallamnā maʿa l-awlādi kathīran, wa qulnā lahum: naḥnu nastahliku l-kahrabāʾa kathīran jiddan, wa hādhā yuʾaththiru fī mīzāniyyati l-bayt, wa lākin lā mustajība limā naqūl
dialogue.en: We talked to the children a lot and told them we use too much electricity and it affects the home budget, but nobody responds.
dialogue.ur: Humne bachon se bahut baat ki aur kaha ke hum bahut bijli istemal karte hain, is se ghar ka budget mutassir hota hai, magar koi sunta nahi.

dialogue.ar: لَدَيَّ فِكْرَةٌ، نَقولُ لِلأَوْلادِ، إِذا انْخَفَضَ اسْتِهْلاكُ الكَهْرَباءِ، فَسَوْفَ نُعْطي كُلَّ واحِدٍ مُكافَأَةً.
dialogue.tr: ladayya fikra, naqūlu lil-awlādi, idhā inkhafaḍa istihlāku l-kahrabāʾi, fasawfa nuʿṭī kulla wāḥidin mukāfaʾa
dialogue.en: I have an idea. We tell the children: if electricity use goes down, we will give each one a reward.
dialogue.ur: Mere paas ek khayal hai. Bachon se kahte hain: agar bijli ka istemal kam hua to har ek ko inaam denge.

dialogue.ar: هَيّا نُجَرِّبْ هذا الأُسْلوبَ.
dialogue.tr: hayyā nujarrib hādhā l-uslūb
dialogue.en: Come on, let's try this method.
dialogue.ur: Chalo yeh tareeqa aazmate hain.

dialogue.ar: ما شاءَ اللهُ، انْخَفَضَتْ فاتورَةُ الكَهْرَباءِ كَثيراً هذا الشَّهْرَ. أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ أُسْلوبَنا نَجَحَ.
dialogue.tr: mā shāʾa llāh, inkhafaḍat fātūratu l-kahrabāʾi kathīran hādhā sh-shahr. aʿtaqidu anna uslūbanā najaḥ
dialogue.en: Mashallah, the bill dropped a lot this month. I think our method worked.
dialogue.ur: Masha Allah, is mahine bill bahut kam aaya. Mera khayal hai hamara tareeqa kamyab raha.

dialogue.ar: وَأَيْنَ مُكافَأَةُ الأَوْلادِ؟
dialogue.tr: wa ayna mukāfaʾatu l-awlād
dialogue.en: And where is the children's reward?
dialogue.ur: Aur bachon ka inaam kahan hai?

dialogue.ar: سَأُحْضِرُها مَعي، إِنْ شاءَ اللهُ.
dialogue.tr: saʾuḥḍiruhā maʿī, in shāʾa llāh
dialogue.en: I will bring it with me, God willing.
dialogue.ur: Main le aaunga, in sha Allah.

q.en: What happened to the electricity bill at first?
q.ur: Shuru mein bill ke saath kya hua?
q.ar: ماذا حَدَثَ لِفاتورَةِ الكَهْرَباءِ في البِدايَةِ؟

q.en: What does the father promise the children?
q.ur: Walid bachon se kya waada karte hain?

options: A reward for each one if they lower consumption / Har ek ko inaam
options_ar: مُكافَأَةً لِكُلِّ واحِدٍ إِذا قَلَّلوا الاِسْتِهْلاكَ

q.ur: 'Fuzool kharchi' ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني الإِنْفاقَ الزّائِدَ بِلا فائِدَةٍ؟

title.en: Sounds review and signs of the genitive
title.ur: Aawaazein aur ism ke jarr ki nishaaniyan

intro.en: First we practise telling similar sounds apart (like ق/د, ن/ع). Then a grammar point: a noun after a preposition (like مِنْ, في, عِنْدَ) is 'majrūr'. Its ending changes: kasra for a singular noun (مِنَ المَدْرَسَةِ), ya for dual and sound masculine plural (مِنَ الطّالِبَيْنِ), and fatha for diptotes (مِنْ أَحْمَدَ).
intro.ur: Pehle milti julti aawaazon mein farq karna mashq karte hain. Phir qaida: harf-e-jarr (مِنْ، في، عِنْدَ) ke baad ism 'majrūr' hota hai. Mufrad par kasra (مِنَ المَدْرَسَةِ), muthanna aur jama muzakkar saalim par ya (مِنَ الطّالِبَيْنِ), aur mamnoo' minas-sarf par fatha (مِنْ أَحْمَدَ).
intro.ar: نَتَدَرَّبُ أَوَّلاً عَلى التَّفْريقِ بَيْنَ أَصْواتٍ مُتَشابِهَةٍ مِثْلَ ق/د وَن/ع. ثُمَّ قاعِدَةٌ: الاِسْمُ بَعْدَ حَرْفِ الجَرِّ (مِنْ، في، عِنْدَ) مَجْرورٌ، وَعَلامَتُهُ الكَسْرَةُ في المُفْرَدِ (مِنَ المَدْرَسَةِ)، وَالياءُ في المُثَنّى وَجَمْعِ المُذَكَّرِ السّالِمِ (مِنَ الطّالِبَيْنِ)، وَالفَتْحَةُ في المَمْنوعِ مِنَ الصَّرْفِ (مِنْ أَحْمَدَ).

q.en: Which sign shows a singular noun is majrūr?
q.ur: Mufrad ism ke majrūr hone ki nishani kaun si hai?

q.en: Which is correct for the dual 'two students' after مِنَ?
q.ur: 'Do talib-ilm' ke liye مِنَ ke baad durust kaun sa hai?

q.en: «مِنْ أَحْمَدَ» ends with fatha because أَحْمَد is:
q.ur: «مِنْ أَحْمَدَ» mein fatha kyun hai? kyunke أَحْمَد:

q.en: A sound masculine plural is majrūr with:
q.ur: Jama muzakkar saalim ka jarr kis se hota hai?

q.en: Which phrase has a noun from the five nouns, majrūr?
q.ur: Asma-e-khamsa wala majrūr jumla kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ عِبارَةٍ فيها اِسْمٌ مِنَ الأَسْماءِ الخَمْسَةِ مَجْرورٌ؟

title.en: Listening and speaking: water and electricity
title.ur: Sunna aur bolna: paani aur bijli

intro.en: Here you listen to a news report about Arab rivers, seas, water shortage and solar energy, then answer short questions. Then you discuss with classmates the uses of electricity and how to save water and power.
intro.ur: Yahan aap arab nadiyon, samundron, paani ki qillat aur sooraj ki tawanai ki khabar sun kar mukhtasar jawab dete hain. Phir sathiyon ke saath bijli ke faide aur paani/bijli bachane par baat karte hain.
intro.ar: تَسْتَمِعُ إِلى تَقْريرٍ عَنِ الأَنْهارِ وَالبِحارِ العَرَبِيَّةِ وَنَقْصِ المِياهِ وَالطّاقَةِ الشَّمْسِيَّةِ، ثُمَّ تُجيبُ عَنْ أَسْئِلَةٍ قَصيرَةٍ. بَعْدَ ذلِكَ تُناقِشُ مَعَ زُمَلائِكَ فَوائِدَ الكَهْرَباءِ وَطُرُقَ تَوْفيرِ الماءِ وَالطّاقَةِ.

options_ar: مَجْرًى مائِيٌّ عَذْبٌ يَجْري في اليابِسَةِ

intro.en: This reading explains why oil is called 'black gold', how industries use it, where it is found, and why we must protect it because it is limited. Learn the key words in the vocabulary list.
intro.ur: Is parhne mein bataya gaya hai ke tel ko 'kaala sona' kyun kehte hain, sanatein isay kaise istemal karti hain, yeh kahan paya jata hai aur isay kyun bachana chahiye kyunke yeh mehdood hai. Aham alfaaz vocab mein dekhein.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلقِراءَةِ يَشْرَحُ لِماذا يُسَمّى النَّفْطُ «الذَّهَبَ الأَسْوَدَ»، وَكَيْفَ تَسْتَعْمِلُهُ الصِّناعاتُ، وَأَيْنَ يوجَدُ، وَلِماذا يَجِبُ أَنْ نَحْمِيَهُ لِأَنَّهُ مَحْدودٌ. تَعَلَّمِ الكَلِماتِ المُهِمَّةَ في قائِمَةِ المُفْرَداتِ.

dialogue.ar: النِّفْطُ مِنْ أَهَمِّ الثَّرَواتِ الطَّبيعِيَّةِ في العالَمِ.
dialogue.tr: an-nafṭu min ahammi th-tharawāti ṭ-ṭabīʿiyyati fī l-ʿālam
dialogue.en: Oil is one of the most important natural resources in the world.
dialogue.ur: Tel duniya ke sab se aham qudrati wasaail mein se hai.

dialogue.ar: وَلِذلِكَ يَعُدُّهُ بَعْضُ النّاسِ الذَّهَبَ الأَسْوَدَ، وَيَعُدُّهُ آخَرونَ شِرْيانَ الحَياةِ.
dialogue.tr: wa li-dhālika yaʿudduhu baʿḍu n-nāsi dh-dhahaba l-aswad, wa yaʿudduhu ākharūna shiryāna l-ḥayāh
dialogue.en: So some people call it black gold, and others call it the artery of life.
dialogue.ur: Is liye kuch log ise kaala sona aur kuch zindagi ki shah-rag kehte hain.

dialogue.ar: لِأَنَّ السَّيّاراتِ وَالشّاحِناتِ وَالقِطاراتِ وَالسُّفُنَ وَالطّائِراتِ تَعْتَمِدُ عَلَيْهِ.
dialogue.tr: li-anna s-sayyārāti wash-shāḥināti wal-qiṭārāti was-sufuna waṭ-ṭāʾirāti taʿtamidu ʿalayh
dialogue.en: Because cars, trucks, trains, ships and planes depend on it.
dialogue.ur: Kyunke gaadiyan, trucks, rail, jahaz aur hawai jahaz isi par munhasir hain.

dialogue.ar: وَيُوَفِّرُ النِّفْطُ نِصْفَ الطّاقَةِ الَّتي يَسْتَهْلِكُها الإِنْسانُ.
dialogue.tr: wa yuwaffiru n-nafṭu niṣfa ṭ-ṭāqati llatī yastahlikuhā l-insān
dialogue.en: Oil provides half of the energy that people use.
dialogue.ur: Tel insaan ki istemal ki hui tawanai ka aadha faraham karta hai.

dialogue.ar: تَعْتَمِدُ مُعْظَمُ الدُّوَلِ الصِّناعِيَّةِ عَلى النِّفْطِ، وَتَسْتَخْدِمُهُ في أَشْياءَ كَثيرَةٍ مِنْها: وَقوداً لِلْمَرْكَباتِ، وَفي صِناعَةِ المَنْسوجاتِ وَمُسْتَحْضَراتِ التَّجْميلِ وَالسَّجّادِ وَالبَلاسْتيكِ وَالأَسْمِدَةِ.
dialogue.tr: taʿtamidu muʿẓamu d-duwali ṣ-ṣināʿiyyati ʿalā n-nafṭ, wa tastakhdimuhu fī ashyāʾa kathīra minhā: waqūdan lil-markabāt, wa fī ṣināʿati l-mansūjāt wa mustaḥḍarāti t-tajmīl was-sajjād wal-blāstīk wal-asmida
dialogue.en: Most industrial countries depend on oil and use it for many things: fuel for vehicles, textiles, cosmetics, carpets, plastic and fertilizers.
dialogue.ur: Aksar sanati mulk tel par munhasir hain aur kai kaamon mein lete hain: gaadiyon ka eendhan, kapda, cosmetics, qaleen, plastic aur khaad.

dialogue.ar: يَحاوِلُ العُلَماءُ البَحْثَ عَنْ بَديلٍ آخَرَ لِلنِّفْطِ، وَلكِنْ يَبْدو أَنَّ البَحْثَ سَيَسْتَغْرِقُ وَقْتاً طَويلاً.
dialogue.tr: yuḥāwilu l-ʿulamāʾu l-baḥtha ʿan badīlin ākhara lin-nafṭ, wa lākin yabdū anna l-baḥtha sayastaghriqu waqtan ṭawīlan
dialogue.en: Scientists try to find another alternative to oil, but the search seems it will take a long time.
dialogue.ur: Science-daan tel ka dusra badal dhoondne ki koshish karte hain, magar lagta hai ismein lamba waqt lage ga.

dialogue.ar: يَصِلُ احْتِياطُ النِّفْطِ في العالَمِ إِلى نَحْوِ ٩٠٠ مِلْيار بَرْميلٍ، وَمِنْ أَهَمِّ المَناطِقِ الَّتي يوجَدُ فيها النِّفْطُ دُوَلُ الخَليجِ العَرَبِيِّ.
dialogue.tr: yaṣilu iḥtiyāṭu n-nafṭi fī l-ʿālami ilā naḥwi tisʿimiʾati milyāri barmīl, wa min ahammi l-manāṭiqi llatī yūjadu fīhā n-nafṭu duwalu l-khalīji l-ʿarabiyy
dialogue.en: The world's oil reserve reaches about 900 billion barrels, and among the most important regions with oil are the Arab Gulf states.
dialogue.ur: Duniya ka tel ka zakheera taqreeban 900 arab barrel hai, aur aham ilaqon mein khaleeji arab mumalik hain.

dialogue.ar: وَالنِّفْطُ مَحْدودٌ في العالَمِ، وَسَيَنْتَهي في يَوْمٍ مِنَ الأَيّامِ، وَلِذلِكَ يَجِبُ عَلى الأَفْرادِ وَالدُّوَلِ المُحافَظَةُ عَلَيْهِ.
dialogue.tr: wan-nafṭu maḥdūdun fī l-ʿālam, wa sayantahī fī yawmin mina l-ayyām, wa li-dhālika yajibu ʿalā l-afrādi wad-duwali l-muḥāfaẓatu ʿalayh
dialogue.en: Oil is limited in the world and will end one day, so individuals and states must protect it.
dialogue.ur: Tel duniya mein mehdood hai aur ek din khatam ho jaye ga, is liye afraad aur mumalik par isay bachana lazim hai.

q.en: Why do some people call oil 'black gold'?
q.ur: Kuch log tel ko 'kaala sona' kyun kehte hain?

options: Because it is very valuable / Bahut qeemti hai
Because it is found in gold mines
Because it is dark at night

q.en: What does the text say about oil?
q.ur: Matn tel ke baare mein kya kehta hai?

options: It is limited and will end one day / Mehdood hai
It is found only in one country
options_ar: أَنَّهُ يوجَدُ في بَلَدٍ واحِدٍ فَقَطْ

options: Half of the energy / Aadhi tawanai
options_ar: واحِدٌ مِنِ اثْنَيْنِ مُتَساوِيَيْنِ مِنَ الطّاقَةِ

q.en: What should individuals and states do about oil?
q.ur: Afraad aur mumalik ko tel ke baare mein kya karna chahiye?
q.ar: ماذا يَجِبُ عَلى الأَفْرادِ وَالدُّوَلِ فِعْلُهُ تُجاهَ النَّفْطِ؟

intro.en: A review of five grammar topics: the adverb (ظَرْف) of time or place, the five nouns, the number's tamyiz (noun after a number), the five verbs, and the vocative (المُنادى).
intro.ur: Paanch nahwi mauzoo'at ka muraja'a: zarf (waqt ya jagah), asma-e-khamsa, adad ka tamyeez, af'al-e-khamsa aur munada.
intro.ar: مُراجَعَةٌ لِخَمْسَةِ مَوْضوعاتٍ نَحْوِيَّةٍ: ظَرْفُ الزَّمانِ أَوِ المَكانِ، وَالأَسْماءُ الخَمْسَةُ، وَتَمْييزُ العَدَدِ، وَالأَفْعالُ الخَمْسَةُ، وَالمُنادى.

q.en: Which is an adverb of time?
The five verbs are present tense verbs joined to:
q.ur: Af'al-e-khamsa mudari' hain jin ke saath juRe hon:
q.ar: الأَفْعالُ الخَمْسَةُ أَفْعالٌ مُضارِعَةٌ يَتَّصِلُ بِها...

options: Alif of dual, waw of group, ya of the addressed woman
options_ar: أَلِفُ الاِثْنَيْنِ أَوْ واوُ الجَماعَةِ أَوْ ياءُ المُخاطَبَةِ

q.en: After a number 11 to 99 the tamyiz noun is:
q.ur: 11 se 99 ke adad ke baad tamyeez hota hai:
q.ar: بَعْدَ الأَعْدادِ مِنْ ١١ إِلى ٩٩ يَكونُ المَعْدودُ...

q.en: In «يا مُحَمَّدُ» the vocative is built on:
Which is one of the five nouns?

intro.en: Hassan and Imad talk about the oil crisis: why fuel prices rise, and the dispute between industrial countries and oil-producing countries. Then a quick drill on words from the same root.
intro.ur: Hassan aur Imad tel ke bohran par baat karte hain: eendhan ki qeematein kyun barhti hain aur sanati mumalik aur tel paida karne wale mumalik mein ikhtilaf kyun hai. Phir ek hi maade ke alfaaz ki mashq.
intro.ar: يَتَحَدَّثُ حَسَنٌ وَعِمادٌ عَنْ أَزْمَةِ النَّفْطِ: لِماذا تَرْتَفِعُ أَسْعارُ الوَقودِ، وَالخِلافُ بَيْنَ الدُّوَلِ الصِّناعِيَّةِ وَالدُّوَلِ المُنْتِجَةِ لِلنَّفْطِ. ثُمَّ تَدْريبٌ سَريعٌ عَلى كَلِماتٍ مِنْ جَذْرٍ واحِدٍ.

dialogue.ar: تَجَدَّدَتْ أَزْمَةُ النِّفْطِ مَرَّةً أُخْرى هذا العامَ.
dialogue.tr: tajaddadat azmatu n-nafṭi marratan ukhrā hādhā l-ʿām
dialogue.en: The oil crisis has returned this year.
dialogue.ur: Is saal tel ka bohran phir laut aaya.

dialogue.ar: وَقَفَزَتْ أَسْعارُ الوَقودِ مِنْ جَديدٍ، وَأَصْبَحَ المَعْروضُ مِنْهُ قَليلاً في مَحَطّاتِ الوَقودِ.
dialogue.tr: wa qafazat asʿāru l-waqūdi min jadīd, wa aṣbaḥa l-maʿrūḍu minhu qalīlan fī maḥaṭṭāti l-waqūd
dialogue.en: Fuel prices jumped again and the supply at petrol stations became small.
dialogue.ur: Eendhan ki qeematein phir uchhal gayin aur petrol pumpon par supply kam ho gayi.

dialogue.ar: أَنا لا أَسْتَخْدِمُ سَيّارَتي الآنَ، وَأَذْهَبُ إِلى الشَّرِكَةِ بِالحافِلَةِ.
dialogue.tr: anā lā astakhdimu sayyāratī l-āna, wa adhhabu ilā sh-sharikati bil-ḥāfila
dialogue.en: I do not use my car now, and I go to the company by bus.
dialogue.ur: Main ab apni gaadi istemal nahi karta, company bus se jata hoon.

dialogue.ar: ما أَسْبابُ أَزْمَةِ النِّفْطِ؟
dialogue.tr: mā asbābu azmati n-nafṭ
dialogue.en: What are the causes of the oil crisis?
dialogue.ur: Tel ke bohran ki wajuhaat kya hain?

dialogue.ar: هُناكَ خِلافٌ بَيْنَ الدُّوَلِ الصِّناعِيَّةِ، وَبَيْنَ الدُّوَلِ المُنْتِجَةِ لِلنِّفْطِ.
dialogue.tr: hunāka khilāfun bayna d-duwali ṣ-ṣināʿiyya, wa bayna d-duwali l-muntijati lin-nafṭ
dialogue.en: There is a dispute between the industrial countries and the oil-producing countries.
dialogue.ur: Sanati mumalik aur tel paida karne wale mumalik ke beech ikhtilaf hai.

dialogue.ar: لِماذا تَخْتَلِفُ تِلْكَ الدُّوَلُ؟
dialogue.tr: limādhā takhtalifu tilka d-duwal
dialogue.en: Why do those countries differ?
dialogue.ur: Yeh mumalik ikhtilaf kyun karte hain?

dialogue.ar: تَدَّعي الدُّوَلُ الصِّناعِيَّةُ أَنَّ الدُّوَلَ المُنْتِجَةَ لِلنِّفْطِ تَرْفَعُ الأَسْعارَ، وَتَقولُ الدُّوَلُ المُنْتِجَةُ لِلنِّفْطِ إِنَّ الدُّوَلَ الصِّناعِيَّةَ تَفْرِضُ ضَرائِبَ عالِيَةً عَلى الوَقودِ.
dialogue.tr: taddaʿī d-duwalu ṣ-ṣināʿiyyatu anna d-duwala l-muntijata lin-nafṭi tarfaʿu l-asʿār, wa taqūlu d-duwalu l-muntijatu lin-nafṭi inna d-duwala ṣ-ṣināʿiyyata tafriḍu ḍarāʾiba ʿāliyatan ʿalā l-waqūd
dialogue.en: Industrial countries claim producers raise prices, and producers say industrial countries impose high taxes on fuel.
dialogue.ur: Sanati mumalik kehte hain ke paida karne wale qeematein barhate hain, aur paida karne wale kehte hain ke sanati mumalik eendhan par bhari tax lagate hain.

dialogue.ar: وَما ذَنْبُ الَّذينَ يَعيشونَ في الدُّوَلِ الفَقيرَةِ؟!
dialogue.tr: wa mā dhanbu lladhīna yaʿīshūna fī d-duwali l-faqīra
dialogue.en: And what is the fault of those living in poor countries?!
dialogue.ur: Aur ghareeb mulkon mein rehne walon ka kya qusoor?!

dialogue.ar: لا عَجَبَ في ذلِكَ، فَنَحْنُ دُوَلٌ فَقيرَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: lā ʿajaba fī dhālik, fanaḥnu duwalun faqīra
dialogue.en: No wonder, we are poor countries.
dialogue.ur: Koi hairat nahi, hum ghareeb mumalik hain.

dialogue.ar: وَلَيْسَ لَدَيْهِمْ صِناعاتٌ يَبيعونَها، وَلا نِفْطٌ يُصَدِّرونَهُ.
dialogue.tr: wa laysa ladayhim ṣināʿātun yabīʿūnahā, wa lā nafṭun yuṣaddirūnah
dialogue.en: They have no industries to sell and no oil to export.
dialogue.ur: Unke paas bechne ko sanatein hain na bhejne ko tel.

dialogue.ar: تُفَكِّرُ الدُّوَلُ الصِّناعِيَّةُ في شُعوبِها فَقَطْ، وَلا تُفَكِّرُ في غَيْرِهِمْ؟!
dialogue.tr: tufakkiru d-duwalu ṣ-ṣināʿiyyatu fī shuʿūbihā faqaṭ, wa lā tufakkiru fī ghayrihim
dialogue.en: Industrial countries think only of their own peoples, and do not think of others?!
dialogue.ur: Sanati mumalik sirf apni qaumon ka sochte hain, doosron ka nahi?!

dialogue.ar: كانَ اللهُ في عَوْنِ الفُقَراءِ.
dialogue.tr: kāna llāhu fī ʿawni l-fuqarāʾ
dialogue.en: May Allah help the poor.
dialogue.ur: Allah ghareebon ki madad kare.

q.en: Why does Hassan go by bus now?
q.ur: Hassan ab bus se kyun jata hai?

options: He does not use his car because of the fuel crisis / Eendhan ka bohran hai
options_ar: لا يَسْتَعْمِلُ سَيّارَتَهُ بِسَبَبِ أَزْمَةِ الوَقودِ

q.en: What do industrial countries claim about the producers?
q.ur: Sanati mumalik paida karne walon ke baare mein kya kehte hain?
q.ar: ماذا تَدَّعي الدُّوَلُ الصِّناعِيَّةُ عَنِ الدُّوَلِ المُنْتِجَةِ؟

options: They raise prices / Qeematein barhate hain

q.ur: Paida karne wale mumalik kya kehte hain?

options: Industrial countries impose high taxes on fuel / Sanati mumalik bhari tax lagate hain
options_ar: إِنَّ الدُّوَلَ الصِّناعِيَّةَ تَفْرِضُ ضَرائِبَ عالِيَةً عَلى الوَقودِ

intro.en: More review: the circumstantial state (الحال) describes the state of the doer or of the object; nouns are indefinite or definite (a name, or with ال). Then you practise asking and answering about oil in your own country.
intro.ur: Mazeed muraja'a: haal fa'il ya maf'ool ki haalat bayan karta hai; ism nakira ya ma'rifa hota hai (alam ya ال wala). Phir apne mulk mein tel ke baare mein sawal-jawab mashq karte hain.
intro.ar: مُراجَعَةٌ أُخْرى: الحالُ يَصِفُ هَيْئَةَ الفاعِلِ أَوِ المَفْعولِ بِهِ، وَالاِسْمُ نَكِرَةٌ أَوْ مَعْرِفَةٌ (عَلَمٌ أَوْ مُعَرَّفٌ بِـ «ال»). ثُمَّ تَتَدَرَّبُ عَلى السُّؤالِ وَالجَوابِ عَنِ النَّفْطِ في بَلَدِكَ.

options: The state of the doer or the object / Fa'il ya maf'ool ki haalat
options_ar: هَيْئَةَ الفاعِلِ أَوِ المَفْعولِ بِهِ وَقْتَ الفِعْلِ

q.en: Which is a definite noun with ال?
q.ur: ال wala ma'rifa ism kaun sa?

q.ar: عَمّا يَسْأَلُ السُّؤالُ «هَلْ يُصَدِّرُ بَلَدُكَ النِّفْطَ؟»

intro.en: The sun is the basic source of energy on Earth. This reading explains how people use solar energy for cooking, heating water and making electricity, and why attempts to use it will continue.
intro.ur: Sooraj zameen par tawanai ka asal zariya hai. Is parhne mein hai ke insaan sooraj ki tawanai khana pakane, paani garam karne aur bijli banane mein kaise istemal karta hai, aur ismein koshishein kyun jaari rahengi.
intro.ar: الشَّمْسُ هِيَ المَصْدَرُ الأَساسِيُّ لِلطّاقَةِ عَلى الأَرْضِ. يَشْرَحُ النَّصُّ كَيْفَ يَسْتَعْمِلُ النّاسُ الطّاقَةَ الشَّمْسِيَّةَ في الطَّبْخِ وَتَسْخينِ الماءِ وَتَوْليدِ الكَهْرَباءِ، وَلِماذا سَتَسْتَمِرُّ مُحاوَلاتُ الاِسْتِفادَةِ مِنْها.

dialogue.ar: الشَّمْسُ، هذا النَّجْمُ الَّذي نَراهُ في السَّماءِ، هِيَ المَصْدَرُ الأَساسِيُّ لِلطّاقَةِ عَلى الأَرْضِ.
dialogue.tr: ash-shamsu, hādhā n-najmu lladhī narāhu fī s-samāʾ, hiya l-maṣdaru l-asāsiyyu liṭ-ṭāqati ʿalā l-arḍ
dialogue.en: The sun, this star we see in the sky, is the basic source of energy on Earth.
dialogue.ur: Sooraj, jo sitara hum aasman mein dekhte hain, zameen par tawanai ka bunyadi zariya hai.

dialogue.ar: وَيَعْتَمِدُ الإِنْسانُ وَالحَيَوانُ وَالنَّباتُ عَلى الحَرارَةِ الَّتي تُرْسِلُها أَشِعَّةُ الشَّمْسِ.
dialogue.tr: wa yaʿtamidu l-insānu wal-ḥayawānu wan-nabātu ʿalā l-ḥarārati llatī tursiluhā ashiʿʿatu sh-shams
dialogue.en: Humans, animals and plants depend on the heat sent by the sun's rays.
dialogue.ur: Insaan, janwar aur paudhe us garmi par munhasir hain jo sooraj ki kirnein bhejti hain.

dialogue.ar: وَلَوْلا هذِهِ الحَرارَةُ لَما وُجِدَتْ حَياةٌ عَلى الأَرْضِ بِأَمْرٍ مِنَ اللهِ.
dialogue.tr: wa lawlā hādhihi l-ḥarāratu lamā wujidat ḥayātun ʿalā l-arḍi bi-amrin mina llāh
dialogue.en: Without this heat, there would be no life on Earth, by Allah's command.
dialogue.ur: Is garmi ke baghair Allah ke hukm se zameen par zindagi na hoti.

dialogue.ar: اِسْتَفادَ الإِنْسانُ مِنْ طاقَةِ الشَّمْسِ قَديماً، فَقَدِ اسْتَعانَ بِها عَلى طَبْخِ الطَّعامِ، وَتَسْخينِ المِياهِ، وَتَدْفِئَةِ البُيوتِ وَتَبْريدِها.
dialogue.tr: istafāda l-insānu min ṭāqati sh-shamsi qadīman, faqadi staʿāna bihā ʿalā ṭabkhi ṭ-ṭaʿām, wa taskhīni l-miyāh, wa tadfiʾati l-buyūti wa tabrīdihā
dialogue.en: People benefited from solar energy long ago: for cooking, heating water, and warming and cooling houses.
dialogue.ur: Insaan purane zamane se sooraj ki tawanai se faida utha raha hai: khana pakane, paani garam karne aur gharon ko garm aur thanda karne mein.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ نَجَحَ العُلَماءُ في تَوْليدِ الكَهْرَباءِ عَنْ طَريقِ خَلايا خاصَّةٍ، أَقاموها في البِلادِ الَّتي تَكونُ الشَّمْسُ فيها حارَّةً مُعْظَمَ الوَقْتِ.
dialogue.tr: wa qad najaḥa l-ʿulamāʾu fī tawlīdi l-kahrabāʾi ʿan ṭarīqi khalāyā khāṣṣa, aqāmūhā fī l-bilādi llatī takūnu sh-shamsu fīhā ḥārratan muʿẓama l-waqt
dialogue.en: Scientists succeeded in generating electricity through special cells, set up in countries where the sun is hot most of the time.
dialogue.ur: Science-daanon ne khaas khaliyon se bijli banane mein kamyabi pai, un mulkon mein jahan sooraj zyada waqt garm rehta hai.

dialogue.ar: تُوضَعُ أَلْواحٌ تُسَمَّى الأَلْواحَ الشَّمْسِيَّةَ فَوْقَ البُيوتِ، تُجَمِّعُ حَرارَةَ الشَّمْسِ وَتُحَوِّلُها إِلى طاقَةٍ كَهْرَبائِيَّةٍ.
dialogue.tr: tūḍaʿu alwāḥun tusammā l-alwāḥa sh-shamsiyya fawqa l-buyūt, tujammiʿu ḥarārata sh-shamsi wa tuḥawwiluhā ilā ṭāqatin kahrabāʾiyya
dialogue.en: Panels called solar panels are placed on roofs; they collect the sun's heat and turn it into electricity.
dialogue.ur: Chhaton par solar panels lagaye jate hain, jo sooraj ki garmi jama kar ke bijli mein badalte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَالطّاقَةُ الَّتي نَأْخُذُها مِنَ الشَّمْسِ نَظيفَةٌ، وَهِيَ مَوْجودَةٌ بِكَثْرَةٍ في المَناطِقِ المُشْمِسَةِ.
dialogue.tr: waṭ-ṭāqatu llatī naʾkhudhuhā mina sh-shamsi naẓīfa, wa hiya mawjūdatun bi-kathratin fī l-manāṭiqi l-mushmisa
dialogue.en: The energy we take from the sun is clean and plentiful in sunny regions.
dialogue.ur: Sooraj se mili hui tawanai saaf hai aur dhoop wale ilaqon mein bohat hai.

dialogue.ar: وَمَعَ ذلِكَ، فَإِنَّ مُحاوَلاتِ اسْتِغْلالِ الطّاقَةِ الشَّمْسِيَّةِ لَنْ تَتَوَقَّفَ؛ لِأَنَّ مَصادِرَ الطّاقَةِ الأُخْرى سَتَنْفَدُ في يَوْمٍ ما، أَمّا الشَّمْسُ فَباقِيَةٌ إِلى يَوْمِ القِيامَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wa maʿa dhālika, fa-inna muḥāwalāti istighlāli ṭ-ṭāqati sh-shamsiyyati lan tatawaqqafa; li-anna maṣādira ṭ-ṭāqati l-ukhrā satanfadu fī yawmin mā, ammā sh-shamsu fa-bāqiyatun ilā yawmi l-qiyāma
dialogue.en: Still, attempts to use solar energy will not stop, because other sources will run out one day, while the sun remains until the Day of Resurrection.
dialogue.ur: Phir bhi sooraj ki tawanai se faida uthane ki koshishein nahi rukengi, kyunke doosre zaraye ek din khatam ho jayenge, jabke sooraj qayamat tak baqi hai.

q.en: What is the basic source of energy on Earth?
q.ur: Zameen par tawanai ka bunyadi zariya kya hai?
q.ar: ما المَصْدَرُ الأَساسِيُّ لِلطّاقَةِ عَلى الأَرْضِ؟

options_ar: أَجْهِزَةٌ تَلْتَقِطُ ضَوْءَ الشَّمْسِ وَتُحَوِّلُهُ إِلى كَهْرَباءَ

q.ur: Sooraj ki tawanai kahan bohat hai?

options: In sunny regions / Dhoop wale ilaqon mein

q.en: Why will attempts to use solar energy not stop?
q.ur: Sooraj ki tawanai ki koshishein kyun nahi rukengi?
q.ar: لِماذا لَنْ تَتَوَقَّفَ مُحاوَلاتُ اِسْتِعْمالِ الطّاقَةِ الشَّمْسِيَّةِ؟

options: Other sources will run out, the sun remains / Doosre zaraye khatam honge
options_ar: لِأَنَّ المَصادِرَ الأُخْرى سَتَنْفَدُ وَالشَّمْسُ باقِيَةٌ

intro.en: A big review: separate and attached pronouns, 'kāna' and 'inna' (the نَواسِخ), the dual and sound masculine plural endings, and the five nouns (أَبو/أَبا/أَبي). Example: المُسْلِمونَ (nominative) but المُؤْمِنينَ (accusative or genitive).
intro.ur: Bara muraja'a: zamair, kana aur inna, muthanna aur jama muzakkar saalim ke aakhir, aur asma-e-khamsa (أَبو/أَبا/أَبي). Misal: المُسْلِمونَ (marfoo') lekin المُؤْمِنينَ (mansoob ya majroor).
intro.ar: مُراجَعَةٌ كَبيرَةٌ: الضَّمائِرُ المُنْفَصِلَةُ وَالمُتَّصِلَةُ، وَ«كانَ» وَ«إِنَّ» (النَّواسِخُ)، وَنِهاياتُ المُثَنّى وَجَمْعِ المُذَكَّرِ السّالِمِ، وَالأَسْماءُ الخَمْسَةُ (أَبو/أَبا/أَبي). مِثالٌ: المُسْلِمونَ (مَرْفوعٌ) وَالمُؤْمِنينَ (مَنْصوبٌ أَوْ مَجْرورٌ).

q.en: المُسْلِمونَ ends with waw because it is:
q.ur: المُسْلِمونَ mein waw kyun hai? kyunke yeh:

q.en: المُؤْمِنينَ is used in the case of:
q.ur: المُؤْمِنينَ kis halat mein aata hai?

options: Accusative or genitive / Nasb ya jarr

q.en: «أَبا هُرَيْرَةَ» has alif because it is a five-noun in:
q.ar: في أَيِّ حالَةٍ إِعْرابِيَّةٍ جاءَتْ «أَبا» في «أَبا هُرَيْرَةَ»؟

intro.en: Writing practice. You write short topics: 'The problem of electricity use at home', 'Oil is the most important source of energy', and 'The oil crisis'. Then you copy a line of poetry in Ruq'a script, and learn a spelling rule: drop the final ya of a 'manqūṣ' noun when it has no ال and is not mudaf (e.g. مُحامٍ).
intro.ur: Likhne ki mashq. Aap in mauzoo'at par likhte hain: 'Ghar mein bijli ke istemal ka masla', 'Tel tawanai ka sab se aham zariya', aur 'Tel ka bohran'. Phir ruq'a khat mein ek sher likhte hain, aur imla ka qaida: ism-e-manqoos ki aakhri ya hazf hoti hai jab ال na ho aur mudaf na ho (jaise مُحامٍ).
intro.ar: تَدْريبٌ عَلى الكِتابَةِ: مَوْضوعاتٌ قَصيرَةٌ عَنْ «مُشْكِلَةِ اِسْتِهْلاكِ الكَهْرَباءِ في البَيْتِ» وَ«النِّفْطُ أَهَمُّ مَصْدَرٍ لِلطّاقَةِ» وَ«أَزْمَةِ النَّفْطِ». ثُمَّ تَنْسَخُ بَيْتَ شِعْرٍ بِخَطِّ الرُّقْعَةِ، وَتَتَعَلَّمُ قاعِدَةً إِمْلائِيَّةً: تُحْذَفُ ياءُ الاِسْمِ المَنْقوصِ إِذا لَمْ يَكُنْ مُعَرَّفاً بِـ «ال» وَلا مُضافاً، مِثْلَ «مُحامٍ».

vocab.en: noun ending in a long i (ya)

q.en: Which is a topic to write about in this lesson?
q.ur: Is sabaq mein kis mauzoo par likhna hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ عُنْوانٍ مَوْضوعٌ لِلكِتابَةِ في هذا الدَّرْسِ؟
ما المَقْصودُ بِعِبارَةِ «النِّفْطُ أَهَمُّ مَصْدَرٍ لِلطّاقَةِ»؟

options: Oil is the most important source of energy
options_ar: أَنَّ النَّفْطَ أَكْبَرُ مَصادِرِ الطّاقَةِ قيمَةً

q.en: When is the final ya of a manqūṣ noun dropped?
q.ur: Manqoos ism ki aakhri ya kab girti hai?

options: When it has no ال and is not mudaf / Jab ال na ho aur mudaf na ho
options_ar: إِذا لَمْ يَكُنْ مُعَرَّفاً بِـ «ال» وَلا مُضافاً

q.ur: Durust imla kaun sa hai (nakira, marfoo')?
q.ar: أَيُّ كِتابَةٍ صَحيحَةٌ لِلاِسْمِ النَّكِرَةِ المَرْفوعِ؟

q.en: The poem line says great souls get tired in:
q.ur: Sher ke mutabiq bari rooheen thakti hain:
q.ar: يَقولُ بَيْتُ الشِّعْرِ إِنَّ النُّفوسَ الكَبيرَةَ تَتْعَبُ في...

options: What their bodies pursue / Apne maqasid mein (jism thakte hain)
options_ar: طَلَبِ ما تَسْعى إِلَيْهِ مِنْ مَقاصِدَ

intro.en: A review test with word lists: electricity and energy words, oil and sun words, pollution and energy words, and common phrases like دُوَل مُنْتِجَة (producing countries) and ذَهَب أَسْوَد (black gold). Also spelling pairs such as مَسْؤولِيَّة and أَداء.
intro.ur: Muraja'a ka imtihan: bijli aur tawanai ke alfaaz, tel aur sooraj ke alfaaz, aur aam jumle jaise دُوَل مُنْتِجَة (paida karne wale mumalik) aur ذَهَب أَسْوَد (kaala sona). Imla ke joray jaise مَسْؤولِيَّة aur أَداء bhi.
intro.ar: اِخْتِبارُ مُراجَعَةٍ فيهِ قَوائِمُ كَلِماتٍ: الكَهْرَباءِ وَالطّاقَةِ، وَالنَّفْطِ وَالشَّمْسِ، وَالتَّلَوُّثِ وَالطّاقَةِ، وَعِباراتٍ شائِعَةٍ مِثْلَ «دُوَل مُنْتِجَة» وَ«ذَهَب أَسْوَد». وَفيهِ أَيْضاً أَزْواجٌ إِمْلائِيَّةٌ مِثْلَ «مَسْؤولِيَّة» وَ«أَداء».

q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني القُوَّةَ الَّتي تُضيءُ المَصابيحَ وَتُشَغِّلُ الأَجْهِزَةَ؟
أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني ما نَحْرِقُهُ لِتَشْغيلِ السَّيّاراتِ؟

q.ur: Tawanai ke tehat kaun sa lafz?

intro.en: The final test covers listening, reading, grammar and vocabulary. There are true/false statements, singular-plural pairs (شَخْص – أَشْخاص), and words with similar meanings (غَرَسَ – زَرَعَ).
intro.ur: Aakhri imtihan mein sunna, parhna, nahw aur alfaaz shamil hain. Sahi/ghalat jumle hain, wahid-jama ke joray (شَخْص – أَشْخاص), aur milte julte maani wale alfaaz (غَرَسَ – زَرَعَ).
intro.ar: يَشْمَلُ الاِخْتِبارُ النِّهائِيُّ الاِسْتِماعَ وَالقِراءَةَ وَالقَواعِدَ وَالمُفْرَداتِ. فيهِ عِباراتٌ صَحيحَةٌ أَوْ خاطِئَةٌ، وَأَزْواجٌ مِنَ المُفْرَدِ وَالجَمْعِ (شَخْص – أَشْخاص)، وَكَلِماتٌ مُتَقارِبَةُ المَعْنى (غَرَسَ – زَرَعَ).

q.en: Which word is close in meaning to «عادَ»?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ قَريبَةٌ في المَعْنى مِنْ «عادَ»؟
